title: Donkey Kong Bananza Review
summary: I never had the nostalgia of Donkey Kong as it was not really my type of game in the 90s. I still bought this game to give a try so here we go!

body.raw:
I never played the old Donky Kong games in the past (other than the origingal arcade donk kong), so this 
is a new monkey expereince for me. I tend to get bored with platform type games like Mario and so on. 
They are fun for a while but I never finish them.

Donk Kong Bananza is more open world and less platform to me. So i'm enjoying it so far, but not to 
say I wont get bored. I'm early on still so this will be an on going game review post.

### Graphics & Presentation
Since the Switch 2 is pretty new theres not too many games that fully take advanatage of the 
full power of Switch 2. So I feel like this game is Nintendos first full Switch 2 feature game. 
I don't count Mario Kart because its not too much different from past Mario Kart in my opinion. 

Graphics is well... Nintendo graphics but what I do like is the destrubale world. Alot of the world 
can be smashed and broken and its over all fun to do so.

I also enjoy the collecting of coings, bananas, etc. Its a good feeling to smash and find hidden items.

### Sound/Audio
Sound is good but also... its a Nintendo sounding game. Here is the hate I will give, no option to 
turn off Music. Why does Nintendo think they know whats best for us. I hate hearing music in a game 
especally if im suppose to be in an emerisve type situation. Nintendo give us the option to turn off 
game music!!!

### Story
I dont know... DK is there and something crashes and theres a talking rock... I'll report back on this.

![4 out of 5 Score](/static/images/GameReview1of5.png)
